Disable all notification popups (silent by default)

- Add ShowNotify master switch (static readonly bool, default false):
  both Toast floating bars and tray balloon tips now no-op when off
- All events (login success, guard start, offline detected, relogin,
  logout) are still written to logs; left-click tray status window
  remains available for feedback
- MessageBox prompts triggered by explicit user actions (logout confirm,
  form validation) are kept as they are interaction, not notification
- Fix: handle AbandonedMutexException in single-instance mutex so the
  app can restart right after being force-killed (previously it crashed)
